design_philosophy.vibe: Clean enterprise B2B WordPress-admin-compatible style. Utilitarian, clean, not trendy or maximalist.
rules: Blue primary CTAs (modern, trustworthy enterprise blue).
White cards on light grey background.
Clear separation between components. No floating old test UI.
Responsive tables/cards with bottom pagination only.
Strict data-testid attributes for all interactive elements (role-based kebab-case).

spacing_and_layout.layout_structure: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with main content area (flex-1) on the right.

sidebar.description: Fixed left navigation mimicking modern enterprise admin panels.
sidebar.styles: bg-white border-r border-slate-200 w-64 h-screen fixed top-0 left-0 flex flex-col py-6 px-4
sidebar.item_normal: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors
sidebar.item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-blue-700

kpi_card.styles: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2

product_card.description: Discovery and Import List item cards.
product_card.styles: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow flex flex-col
product_card.title: text-base font-medium text-slate-900 line-clamp-2

search_bar.description: Unified discovery search with mode selection.
search_bar.styles: flex items-center bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-1 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500 focus-within:border-blue-500
search_bar.dropdown: bg-slate-50 border-r border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 rounded-l-md outline-none
search_bar.input: flex-1 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none bg-transparent

product_studio_tabs.tab_normal: px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 border-b-2 border-transparent transition-colors
product_studio_tabs.tab_active: px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600

ai_inline_action.description: AI rewrite controls placed next to inputs.
ai_inline_action.styles: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 border border-indigo-200 transition-colors

button_primary.styles: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg text-white bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-sm transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2

table.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm
table.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider

hero_background.description: Blue clouds abstract background for login/landing area

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, and critical data containers MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case reflecting their specific role (e.g., 'sidebar-nav-dashboard', 'product-card-import-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for consistent, professional iconography.
Implement Shadcn UI primitives but override standard classes with the styles defined here.
Ensure the sidebar is fixed and the main content area has left margin matching the sidebar width.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Satoshi' for body. Ensure they are imported via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
Populate initial product mocks using the provided media URLs.
